summary: Celcuity Inc. filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) to correct an omitted slide in a presentation and make conforming edits regarding its July 14, 2026 announcement of FDA approval of REVTORPYK (gedatolisib) for HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer without a PIK3CA mutation. The filing discusses regulatory approval, commercial launch plans (late Q3 2026), and intent to submit an sNDA for the PIK3CA-mutated indication in Q3 2026. No special situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved.
